test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who among the following won a Gold Medal at UWW Ranking Series in the 62 kg category held in the month of June 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __Sakshi Malik.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Sakshi Malik won her first international gold medal in almost five years at the Bolat Turlykhanov Cup wrestling tournament- a **UWW Ranking Series event - at Almaty in Kazakhstan on 3 June 2022.**
 
• India’s Mansi Ahlawat and Divya Kakran also finished at the top of the podium in their respective weight categories.
 
• The last time Sakshi Malik won a gold was at the 2017 Commonwealth Championship.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• ​The 30-member Indian contingent participated at the 35th Edition of Asian Wrestling Championships 2022 held in Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia.
 
• Indian wrestlers secured a total of 17 medals, that includes (1-Gold, 5-Silver, and 11-Bronze medals).
 
• Gold Medalist: Ravi Kumar Dahiyais the only Gold medalist representing India.
 
• Ministry of Railways has approved to set up a state-of-art wrestling academy in Indian Railways, at Kishanganj, Delhi. 
 
• The wrestling academy will be the biggest in India and equipped with advanced training facilities to promote the sports of wrestling in the country.
